FISHING LICENCE · UNITED STATES

Colorado fishing licence

Anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. Most adults also pay for a Habitat Stamp; the first two daily licences are exempt.

Buy a licence online ↗Official rules ↗

Updated 2026-11-11

Who needs one

  • Anglers aged 16 or older.

Who doesn’t

  • Children under 16 need no base fishing licence.

Licence options and prices

LicenceForLengthPrice
Non-resident 1-daynon resident1 day$21.90 USD
Non-resident 5-daynon resident5 days$41.04 USD
Non-resident annualnon residentMarch 1, 2026–March 31, 2027$124.01 USD

Extra stamps and permits

  • Habitat Stamp · $12.76 USD
    Usually required once yearly for buyers aged 18–64; the first two one-day/additional-day licences are exempt.
  • Second-rod stamp · $14.24 USD
    Required to use a second rod, including for children under 16.

Rules visitors should know

  • The 2026 annual licence ends March 31, 2027.
  • Show acceptable identification when you buy a licence.

How to buy

Online, at CPW offices or licence agents, or by phone at 1-800-244-5613.

Common license questions

Do I need a fishing licence in Colorado?

Anglers aged 16 or older need a fishing licence. Most adults also pay for a Habitat Stamp; the first two daily licences are exempt.

How much is a visitor fishing licence in Colorado?

Non-resident 1-day: $21.90 USD; Non-resident 5-day: $41.04 USD; Non-resident annual: $124.01 USD (checked November 2026).

Where do I buy a fishing licence in Colorado?

Online, at CPW offices or licence agents, or by phone at 1-800-244-5613.
